clinical-strength-cream:
Clinical is the standard-strength Comfort Cream — the tier most aesthetic appointments call for. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Cream is the broad-coverage format: the default for larger or simpler areas.

Formulated for shorter, routine appointments and smaller areas, and the sensible place to start. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session. If you're between two, the lighter one is usually the sensible start, and you can choose differently next time.

Available in 10g and 30g. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
clinical-strength-gel:
Clinical is the standard-strength Comfort Gel — it holds where you place it, for precise and facial work. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Gel is the precise format: it stays put on facial and contoured areas through a longer sitting.

Formulated for shorter, routine sittings and smaller, defined areas. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session. Strength isn't set by the format — every format comes in all three tiers, so pick the format for the area and the tier for the session.

Available in 15ml and 35ml. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
clinical-strength-spray:
Clinical is the standard-strength Comfort Spray — even, hands-off coverage for larger or awkward areas. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Spray is the coverage format: even passes across a broad area, with no layer to work in by hand.

Formulated for shorter, routine sessions where the area is broad and covering it evenly matters. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session. If you're between two, the lighter one is usually the sensible start.

35ml. Hold a short, consistent distance from the skin and cover the area in even passes, on clean, dry, unbroken skin; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
advanced-strength-cream:
Advanced is the higher-strength Comfort Cream, for regular aesthetic work. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Cream is the broad-coverage format: the default for larger or simpler areas.

Formulated for longer or more sensitive sessions. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session. If your appointments are routine and short, Clinical is the tier to start from — match it to the session you're actually having, not to price.

Available in 10g and 30g. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
advanced-strength-gel:
Advanced is the higher-strength Comfort Gel — for longer facial sittings and more sensitive precise work. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Gel holds where you place it and stays put through a longer sitting.

Formulated for longer or more sensitive sessions on facial and contoured areas. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session. Strength isn't set by the format — every format comes in all three tiers, so pick the format for the area and the tier for the session.

Available in 15ml and 35ml. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
advanced-strength-spray:
Advanced is the higher-strength Comfort Spray — for longer or more sensitive body sessions and larger areas. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Spray gives even, hands-off coverage, with no layer to work in by hand.

Formulated for longer or more sensitive body sessions, and suited to broad areas such as laser and waxing appointments, where sensitivity varies across the area. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session.

35ml. Hold a short, consistent distance from the skin and cover the area in even passes, on clean, dry, unbroken skin; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
professional-strength-cream:
Professional is our practitioner tier — developed with practitioners, for the longest and most sustained appointments. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Cream is the broad-coverage format: the default for larger or simpler areas.

Most sessions don't need the practitioner tier. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session. If yours is routine, Clinical or Advanced is the sensible match. Strength matches the appointment, not the budget.

Available in 30g. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.

foaming-cleanser:
An antibacterial foaming cleanser for the appointment routine — cleanse the area before you start, and again afterwards. A cosmetic product, not a medicine. Not a numbing product. It sits outside the strength range and has no tier.

35ml. For use on unbroken skin; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
